digest.component_or_area: outbound link differ and SupportsLinks capability
propositions: outbound_links.py imports adapters.jira directly to compare vendor link shapes, violating core opaqueness and ADR 0035(d)
link translation logic must move from core (_RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK inline usage) to the Jira adapter's SupportsLinks implementation
canonical link diffing in core must compare only relations, carrying vendor type names as opaque passengers for REMOVE payloads
ADD dedup must remain direction-agnostic, matching local deps against remote links regardless of inward/outward orientation
outbound_differ.py must thread the SupportsLinks capability to _diff_links so core can invoke adapter translations without direct imports
AST gate must enforce zero adapters.jira imports in outbound_links.py post-refactor
